niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, light, airy interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear sectioning, and enough content density to feel complete. They like layouts that are polished and fully populated, with concise copy, subtle integrated search, balanced spacing, and direct controls that are easy to scan. They generally favor modern, restrained styling over heavy, crowded, or overly dramatic presentation, but they still want enough information and actions visible to feel useful and complete.

criteria.description: Clear, strong hierarchy with a prominent title, obvious primary action, and distinct separation between sections and controls.
Light, airy, open-looking screens with restrained visual weight rather than dark, heavy, or crowded presentation.
Fully populated screens that show enough settings, entries, or status information to feel complete rather than sparse or unfinished.
Clearly separated, well-grouped sections that make the page easy to understand at a glance.
Short, direct, and specific copy that avoids wordiness and gets to the point quickly.
Moderate density with readable spacing and breathing room, avoiding both crowding and excessive emptiness.
Modern, streamlined layouts that feel clean and polished rather than busy, dated, or overdesigned.
Visible toggles, buttons, and per-item actions that let the user act immediately instead of only navigating deeper.
Search fields that are integrated into the layout and visually subtle rather than oversized or dominant.
